overall: A lower, dry, conversational continuous read from someone explaining a physical task they understand. Use deliberate clear articulation so the contact, sensing and transfer can register. Keep sentences flowing with ordinary breaths and natural endings; do not drag syllables or manufacture gaps. Keep company attribution neutral throughout. Let precise relationships carry the explanation, and let the human fallback close it calmly.
performance_arc: Question, company attribution, precise physical explanation, firm limit.
pause_units: beats, editorial notes only; excluded from the assembled reader prompt

lines.text: A packed trailer can hide the top of a carton.
lines.intent: Orient to the blocked top as the front plate approaches the conserved carton. Give the physical obstacle a curious, plain statement that creates the gripping question.
lines.energy: Begin at a restrained conversational level, with a small lift on the obstacle and a settled sentence ending.
lines.risk: Covered-top context needs clear articulation; keep the sentence connected.

lines.text: Austin startup Contoro builds robots to unload boxes.
lines.intent: Orient the source and task while the same contact assembly and mounted sensor come into view. Identify the company without turning its activity into an endorsement.
lines.energy: Ease slightly below the opening lift; give the company attribution a neutral factual register and carry forward into the mechanism.
lines.risk: Contoro has no verified specific pronunciation supplied here. Preserve the approved spelling and flag the name for the audible check.

lines.text: Contoro says its gripper holds two sides at once.
lines.intent: Reveal the company-described simultaneous contact as the side plate meets the carton and withdrawal begins. Keep the attribution audible before the physical answer.
lines.energy: Lift modestly from orientation through clearer articulation of the contact relationship, then land the result without a victory inflection.
lines.risk: Retain Contoro says as part of the continuous sentence; the emphasis must not swallow the attribution.

lines.text: The front face and another accessible surface.
lines.intent: Explain which surfaces hold the same withdrawing carton. Treat this short fragment as the completion of the preceding explanation while the covered top becomes exposed.
lines.energy: Step slightly down from the reveal and become more precise; connect this fragment to the preceding thought rather than restarting as a new announcement.
lines.risk: The fragment identifies contact surfaces; avoid a dramatic pause between front face and the second surface.

lines.text: Cameras and sensors locate boxes and container walls.
lines.intent: Explain the sensing input as the lens and qualitative geometry connect the same box to the exposed container wall. Name the objects clearly without implying measured accuracy.
lines.energy: Return to an even explanatory level, a little above the surface detail, with distinct nouns and no acceleration through the geometry.
lines.risk: Keep cameras and sensors together as the subject; this is an illustrated relation without numerical sensor output.

lines.text: Its AI plans paths around the boxes.
lines.intent: Explain the planned movement as an illustrative path develops before the same carton traverses the open space. Carry the cause into its physical consequence.
lines.energy: Sustain the explanatory level with a small forward lift on planning, then settle as the carton reaches the conveyor approach.
lines.risk: Say AI as the letter names. Keep the short sentence conversational instead of making it a slogan.

lines.text: When AI fails, remote operators can take control.
lines.intent: Qualify the autonomy claim at the editorial assistance boundary. The supported carton and pending endpoint introduce a human fallback rather than an observed intervention.
lines.energy: Drop below every earlier line and narrow the pitch range while retaining clear articulation. Make the people who can take control audible over the reduced background.
lines.risk: When AI fails states the limit plainly; avoid alarm, sarcasm or an implication that this film observed a failure.

lines.text: The company combines robot autonomy with human backup.
lines.intent: Resolve the account as the same carton receives roller support and the plates release. Keep the company-described combination and human fallback attached to the completed generic transfer.
lines.energy: Rise only enough from the quiet limit to restore conversational ease, then finish lower and firmer than the central reveal, with a dry downward landing.
lines.risk: The closed physical transfer supplies no reliability or labor-savings claim. End on the human fallback without a celebratory flourish.
